completed_milestones.milestone: Module 1-5: Google Maps Scraper & Lead Harvester
completed_milestones.description: High-volume scraper for local business data with phone, email, website, ratings and social links.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 6 & 7: AI Pitch Generator & Lead Hunter Dashboard
completed_milestones.description: Interactive lead dossier, one-click enrichment, Gemini cold pitch drafting, quick filters.
Centralized database migration script with live connection pooling.
PWA icons, service worker cache, responsive layout for all mobile viewports.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 10: Omnichannel Unified Inbox (WhatsApp Web PC Style)
completed_milestones.description: Full WhatsApp Web clone UI with doodle texture, green bubbles, double blue checkmarks, auto-growing textarea (40px-140px), direct image preview cards with lightbox zoom, clickable links, and independent dual-pane scroll.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 11: Native WhatsApp QR Scanner & ManyChat Instagram Bridge
completed_milestones.description: Integrated Baileys engine for mobile QR scan without third-party fees, plus ManyChat bridge for zero-developer Instagram DMs.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 12: WhatsApp Mobile Native UX (Mobile Viewport)
completed_milestones.description: Separate mobile flow where full-width scrollable chats list is shown first; tapping opens full-screen WhatsApp chat view with back button (←), contact avatar, status, doodle wallpaper, and bottom-anchored composer. Browser back / hardware back button smoothly returns to chats list.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 13: Connection Buttons Verification & Hardening (WhatsApp QR & IMAP Email)
completed_milestones.description: Fixed WhatsApp Baileys infinite 440 (connectionReplaced) reconnect loop by handling replaced sessions and adding generateQr() that clears stale creds for instant fresh QR generation; fixed missing saveAndSyncEmailChannel() in app.js and added IMAP timeouts to prevent network hangs.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 14: Unified Email Config & Inbox Outbound Reply Dispatch
completed_milestones.description: Unified Email configuration across the entire app so Leads cold pitch dispatcher and Omnichannel Inbox share the same AES-256 encrypted SMTP credentials from channel_settings (axurabots@gmail.com). Fixed inbox reply endpoint (/inbox/conversations/:id/reply) to auto-resolve channel credentials and send email replies via SMTP. Verified live email delivery to blinknship@gmail.com.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 15: Background IMAP Inbound Poller & MessageId Deduplication
completed_milestones.description: Added automated background IMAP polling service running every 25 seconds with concurrency lock to automatically fetch prospect replies from Gmail into the Omnichannel Inbox without requiring manual button clicks. Added messageId deduplication in inboxRepository.js to prevent duplicate imports.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 16: Duplicate Send Fix, 2-Phase High-Speed IMAP Sync & RFC Email Threading
completed_milestones.description: Resolved double outbound email sends by removing duplicate keydown listener, enforcing single-execution mutex, and adding a 3.5s server-side debounce map. Re-engineered email inbound sync with a 2-phase fetch (lightweight envelopes first, download source only for genuinely new emails, capped unseen query) to eliminate IMAP lock delays. Added RFC In-Reply-To/References threading headers, mirrored Leads Hunter cold emails into Inbox threads, and cleaned up historical duplicate messages.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 17: Real-Time Inbox Sync & Outbound Dispatch Stability
completed_milestones.description: Eliminated server watch restart thrashing by scoping dev script exclusively to server.js (preventing Supabase connection pool exhaustion and dropped fetch calls), converted IMAP phase 2 source fetch to single-query batch download to eliminate socket timeouts, and revamped frontend real-time poller to track message IDs and bubble counts with auto-scroll to bottom upon new message arrival without requiring page reload. Verified live outbound SMTP delivery to blinknship@gmail.com and bidirectional conversation update.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 18: SMTP Connection Pooling, 12s IMAP Polling & Custom Subject Line
completed_milestones.description: Accelerated outbound email dispatch to ~1.5s using a pooled keepalive SMTP transporter (pool: true, maxConnections: 3), reusing warm TLS connections instead of repeated handshakes. Accelerated IMAP envelope checks by replacing sequential Supabase queries with single batch ANY($1::text[]) mid checks and tightened polling to 12s. Added custom editable email subject line bar in Omnichannel Inbox composer (shown only for email channels, hidden for WhatsApp/IG), updating thread subjects in database upon dispatch.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 19: n8n Meta Omnichannel Bridge (Instagram & Facebook Messenger)
completed_milestones.description: Discovered and booted user's local n8n instance (v2.37.10 on port 5678). Enhanced metaReceiver.js with dynamic multi-channel support (auto-detecting facebook vs instagram). Authored and verified n8n workflows (workflows/n8n_instagram_client_bunny.json and workflows/n8n_meta_omnichannel_client_bunny.json) with normalizer code and forwarder to http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/manychat. Successfully executed and verified end-to-end inbound delivery into Supabase messages (ID 312). Clarified Meta Developer 'Development Mode' policy bypassing legal business verification for self-hosted apps.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 20: Open & Click Tracking Engine, Dynamic Days Elapsed Cadence & Contextual AI Follow-Up Generator
completed_milestones.description: Implemented native Instantly/Lemlist-style email tracking without third-party fees. Extended Supabase outreach_logs and leads schemas with tracking_token, opened_at, last_opened_at, open_count, clicked_at, last_clicked_at, click_count, and follow-up timers. Created modules/tracking/tracker.js with 1x1 transparent GIF server (/api/track/open/:token), hyperlink wrapper (/api/track/click/:token), anti-spam scanner/bot detector, and a 4-stage cadence calculator (Day 0-2 waiting, Day 3-6 gentle bump, Day 7-13 value add, Day 14+ breakup, auto-halt on reply). Connected mailer.js to auto-inject tracking pixels on cold pitches. Built generateFollowUpPitch in aiIntelligence.js tailoring threaded follow-ups ('Re:') using Gemini Flash. Added UI cadence badges, mini tracking pills, filter buttons, and 1-click '⚡ Follow-Up' action in Leads Hunter Dashboard. Verified 100% via unit and end-to-end DB tests.

completed_milestones.milestone: Module 21: Dedicated Tracking & Analytics Dashboard, SVG Migration & Pre-Flight Spam Risk Analyzer
completed_milestones.description: Segregated Outreach Tracking & Cadence into its own dedicated 'Tracking & Analytics' dashboard in the sidebar and bottom mobile nav. Cleaned the Leads table to 5 core business columns. Replaced all emojis with crisp SVG icons. Unified UI to a clean monochrome white theme (#FFFFFF cards, #E4E4E7 borders, #09090B typography). Built a 5-card KPI metric grid, an interactive Pre-Flight Spam Risk Analyzer (/api/tracking/analyze-spam) scoring copy against 15+ B2B cold email spam patterns, and a live Outreach & Cadence Monitor Table (/api/tracking/logs) with engagement signals, cadence badges, and 1-click AI follow-up actions. Fully verified via automated Playwright test suite (tests/verify_tracking_ui.js) including 375px mobile viewport zero-overflow test.

current_checkpoint: Phase 1 fully complete (Modules 1-21) including clean Leads Hunter table, dedicated Tracking & Analytics dashboard with zero emojis, pure white theme, responsive design, deliverability pre-flight spam checker, and automated Playwright test verification. Ready for Phase 2 requirements definition.
